product.description: Monolith™ by Monoprice™M1070C Over the Ear Closed Back Planar HeadphonesMonolith™ M1070C Over the Ear Closed Back Planar Headphones use a 106mm planar magnetic driver enclosed in a gorgeous, closed back housing. It features a plush, padded headband and earpads for comfortable listening over extended periods of time. This makes the M1070C the perfect audiophile choice for those that may need to listen in less than silent environments. COMFORTWeighing less than 23 ounces, the Monolith™ M1070C has been engineered to be comfortable for extended listening sessions.
